final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.ID AS pid, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS gavg FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM g), d AS (SELECT g.pid, g.sex, g.gavg, g.gavg - o.oavg AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oavg IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT sex, AVG(diff) AS savg FROM d GROUP BY sex) SELECT d.pid, d.sex, d.gavg, d.diff, d.diff - s.savg AS diff2 FROM d JOIN s ON d.sex = s.sex WHERE d.diff > s.savg ORDER BY diff2 DESC LIMIT 10
